claim: The sample demo opens in one click and uses storage separate from real recordings.
sandbox: fresh browser; seed a private real recording, enter /demo, reset and exit; assert the real database is unchanged

claim: Recordings stay in the browser and are not uploaded.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1 context; record every request through both exports and assert only the product origin

claim: The installed app works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; install the worker, reload, set the context offline, reload, and assert sample data

claim: Users can choose a 20, 30, or 45 second recording limit.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with a virtual clock; for each duration assert recording continues just before the limit and stops at it

claim: Screen permission is requested only after the record action.
sandbox: fresh real context with an instrumented capture API; assert zero calls before and one after the action

claim: The interface supports keyboard focus and reduced-motion settings.
sandbox: fresh reduced-motion context; use the keyboard skip link and assert motion duration is effectively zero

claim: Microphone audio can be added to a screen recording.
sandbox: fresh real context with synthetic screen and microphone streams; enable the microphone and assert its audio track enters MediaRecorder
fresh /demo context; export and assert the downloaded name and non-empty file

claim: Exports the marked frame as a PNG poster.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; move the beat to 00:02 and 00:15, decode both PNGs, and assert frame pixels plus printed times

claim: Saved recordings remain after a reload.
sandbox: fresh real context with synthetic display media; record, save, reload, and assert the recording

claim: Exports and imports a complete JSON backup.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; export the JSON, inspect embedded media, delete the sample, then import and assert restoration

claim: The free plan saves three recordings while WebM, PNG, and JSON exports remain available.
sandbox: fresh real context with three seeded recordings; make a fourth and assert three persisted plus working WebM, PNG, and JSON exports

claim: A verified Loop Pass saves more than three recordings.
sandbox: fresh real context; mock a valid production-origin returned license, seed three recordings, make a fourth, and assert four saved

claim: A verified Loop Pass exports 1920-pixel posters when the source is large enough.
sandbox: fresh real context with cached valid verdict and 1920px synthetic media; export and decode poster width

claim: A restored license stores its token and latest verification result in this browser after Sociobot verifies it.
sandbox: fresh real context; paste a token, mock the documented verdict, assert unlock and the exact production API origin

claim: An inactive or revoked license does not enable paid features.
sandbox: fresh real context; restore a token against a recorded revoked verdict and assert the free locked state

claim: Loop Pass costs $9 once, and checkout starts on Sociobot before opening a Dodo payment page.
sandbox: fresh page plus live read-only HTTP; assert the exact Sociobot link, 303 Dodo redirect, and hosted checkout $9 one-time content
